validation.notes: Repaired recoverToolInvocation in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: replay now requires the persisted effect_pending policy to be "safe" AND the current tool declaration to exist with replay "safe" AND the invocation not to be cancelled; every other case calls readCheckpoint and publishes interruptedOutcome instead of clearReplayCheckpoint/execute. The regression drives the real recoverToolInvocation and interruptedOutcome through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with boundary fakes and asserts 7 cases: both-safe replays exactly once (events clear/invoke/effect-complete/publish, recovery-marked non-error result); declaration changed to "never" interrupts; missing tool interrupts without throwing or executing; cancelled invocation interrupts; persisted "never" with a now-safe tool interrupts; a declaration without a replay policy interrupts; missing tool with persisted "never" interrupts. Interrupted cases additionally assert the checkpoint content/details are preserved, the interruption marker is appended, the replay checkpoint is not cleared, and no effect-boundary event occurs. Verified the suite exits 0 on the repaired tree and exits 1 with an AssertionError ("declaration changed to \"never\" settles as interrupted, not replayed: ... must not touch the effect boundary") when the guard is reverted to the original condition. Limitation: the repository has no installed node_modules, so vitest/tsc typecheck suites could not be run and no dependencies were installed; validation is the standalone Node 24 assertion script above.
